name: Thrown Bull Rush (Combat)
body:
The power of your attacks when throwing two-handed weapons knocks your foes back.

Prerequisite(s): Improved Bull Rush, Two-Handed Thrower, base attack bonus +6

Benefit(s): As a standard action you can make a ranged bull rush combat maneuver with a thrown two-handed weapon. Unless the weapon already has a range increment, it’s range increment is 10’. If successful the target takes damage from the weapon and is also pushed back per bull rush.

Blood & Steel, Book 1: The Fighter. Copyright 2014, d20pfsrd.com Publishing; Author: Taylor Hubler.
